description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Country' class within the Opencart system, specifically in the Catalog\Model\Localisation namespace. It defines methods to retrieve country details from the database by various identifiers such as country ID, ISO codes, and fetches lists of countries.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: A class that provides methods for fetching country-related data from the database.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves details of a country by its ID.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Retrieves country details by its 2-letter ISO code.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Retrieves country details by its 3-letter ISO code.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Fetches a list of all active countries.
